question: In November 2020, Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveiled a statue of ______ via video conferencing at the Jawaharlal Nehru University campus in Delhi.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi will unveil (through video-conference) the life-size statue of Swami Vivekananda installed in the university campus on **November 12.**
 
• The unveiling of the statue will be preceded by a programme on Swami Vivekananda.
 
• Swami Vivekananda is one of the most beloved intellectuals and spiritual leaders India has been fortunate to produce.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi will unveil a 216-foot statue of Ramanujacharya, described as the 'Statue of Equality in Hyderabad in February 2022.

 
 
• The 216-feet statue of the 11th-century saint and social reformer will be located in a 45-acre complex at Shamshabad.
 
 
 
• The Statue of Unity is the statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the first Home Minister of independent India.
 
 
• The 182-meter tall statue is the world’s tallest statue located in Kevadia, Gujarat. 
 
 
 
• India's largest reclining statue of Lord Buddha is being built in Bodh Gaya.
 
 
• Built by Buddha International Welfare Mission, the statue will be 100 feet long and 30 feet high.
